decision: The packet is internally consistent as a trace of user-transcribed public metadata joined by filename to the existing local/server archive inventory. It identifies 1lmehfi3 / tl3.zip / 0.66832 as the unique top successful row in the supplied 100-row list. It does not establish the bytes or exact recipe of the portal upload.

findings.evidence: INCUMBENT_BINDING.json sets portal_payload_sha256 and actual_portal_payload_sha256 to null. The local archive and server-copy hashes are equal only within the existing inventory and are joined to the reported public row by filename.
findings.required_action: Continue to describe the public ID/filename/score as user-transcribed and the member recipe as the inventoried local/server archive. Do not attribute the archive SHA or its members to portal-uploaded bytes.
findings.title: Portal upload bytes and recipe remain unverified

findings.evidence: The packet preserves a verbatim excerpt through the first five rows; the remaining rows are manual transcription. I independently checked their internal TSV/JSON consistency and computed summaries, but did not have the full original user table available for row-by-row source comparison in this review context.
findings.required_action: Retain the packet’s stated scope: summaries reconcile to the user-supplied 100-total header, but the full transcription is not a verbatim portal export or independent portal verification.
findings.title: The 100-row source is normalized transcription, not a full verbatim archive

findings.evidence: README.md labels the recipe section “What the incumbent contains,” while the binding proves the local/server-copy recipe only and explicitly leaves portal payload bytes unverified.
findings.required_action: If this packet is used to assert the uploaded package composition, qualify the heading as the inventoried local tl3 archive recipe. The body’s existing byte-identity caveat otherwise communicates the limitation.
findings.title: The section heading can imply stronger package identity than the binding establishes

review_scope: Read-only lightweight metadata/source review. No original ZIP was opened or rehashed; no browser/portal query, model/array access, job, test, or execution was performed. The first-five-row excerpt was inspected; full transcript reconciliation to the original user message was not independently repeated.

verified_metadata.catalog_claims: The pinned catalog supports the stated family input counts and model/training distinctions, train-plus-valid fit scope, and the w18 teacher coefficient sum. These are documented catalog facts, not newly replayed training evidence.
verified_metadata.score_comparison: 0.66832 minus the supplied candidate row 0.65839 equals 0.00993; 0.66832 minus 0.66830 equals 0.00002. The packet labels these as displayed public-score differences and makes no causal attribution.
verified_metadata.summary: Recomputed row count/header (100), unique IDs (100), status counts (95 SCORE, 4 SCORE:TIMEOUT, 1 CHECK:ERROR), submitter counts, duplicate filenames, top ten, and the listed duration/missing-field anomalies; all match VALIDATION.json. JSON and TSV row order and all normalized fields match. Displayed score strings agree with numeric scores; failed rows retain an em dash and null numeric score.
verified_metadata.tl3_local_inventory_binding: The exact inventory entry agrees with INCUMBENT_BINDING.json for archive byte count/SHA, member list, and matching server-copy metadata. The tl3 coefficients 0.34/0.33/0.33 sum to 1.00 and match the inventory. The tl4 .25-per-member recipe also matches.
